name: io.github.Muzaqil555/gemini-pro-mcp
title: Gemini Pro MCP
description: Your Google AI Pro plan in Claude, Codex and Gemini CLI: Gemini, Flow, Notebooks, Jules, Veo

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini API key for the video and image tools (optional; these tools are billed)

environmentVariables.name: JULES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Jules API key from jules.google.com/settings (optional, for the jules_* tools)

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_PRO_ENABLE_FLOW
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the Google Flow tools

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_PRO_ENABLE_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable all browser tools (Gemini app, Notebooks, AI Mode)
